text:
Market: green light, VIX ~16. Semis are leading after Micron's blowout quarter (revenue well above estimates, stronger guidance, AI memory supply tight into 2027-28). That lifted AMD and Intel; Micron itself dipped slightly premarket on 'sell the news'.

Your SNOW (+3%): Snowflake upsized its convertible-note sale to $3.75B (closes today). Dilution worries are already in the price; analysts' consensus target is ~$414. The bigger issue is the model: SNOW's rank fell from #2 to #18 this week, so it will most likely be sold at Monday's review.

Monday's likely top 3: AMD, INTC, MU, all chips. Fundamentals look supportive (Micron earnings, Intel's Nvidia OpenShell tie-in, AMD data-center records), but owning three semis means one sector shock hits everything, so position sizes and the 8% stops matter.

Learned this week: across the past year, stocks that gapped down >5% bounced +1.65% more than a normal week over the next 5 days; volume spikes slightly underperformed. Most other signals showed no reliable edge.

cautions.why: Rank fell #2 -> #18; likely rotated out Monday. Upsized $3.75B convertible = dilution overhang.
Likely Monday picks are all semiconductors: sector concentration risk.
Just reported earnings; stock dipped despite a beat (sell-the-news).
